result:
I applied B's patch for the three cart layout bugs exactly as written. Every check came out at B's expected value, so there was no STOP. The bugs aren't fixed until C's browser checks pass, and I haven't marked anything in the backlog.

**What changed** (exactly the three files B allowed; I wrote none of the content myself):
- `app/routes/cart.tsx`: only class names changed, plus `data-lenis-prevent-wheel` on both cart columns.
- `app/lib/__tests__/cart-mobile-layout.test.ts`: new test file.
- `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/323-cart-mobile-items-hidden.md`: new implementation doc.

**Checks I ran** (logs in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-502/`):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Protected and unchanged files, before and after applying (checks 1–4) | all rc 0, including a final re-check after everything else ran |
| Git status at the end | only the 3 files above |
| `npm run typecheck` | rc 0 |
| `npm run lint` | rc 0, 179 warnings |
| Biome on the two code files | rc 0, 5 warnings (already there before) |
| The 3 test files that cover the change | 54/54 pass, CML1–CML4 present |

The code-reviewer approved it with no Critical, High or Medium findings. It confirmed that no checkout, auth, ownership or download code changed, and that the new tests fail on the old version (`3bb55d4`). Its five Low findings are left for B, because changing those bytes would go beyond the patch:
- **Doc wording:** doc 323 l.28 and the task's own D1 ruling text say the wheel reaches the window when a column is "at its end" on desktop. That's not quite right: a column that actually scrolls stops the wheel there. I didn't treat this as a STOP, since no C row depends on it and it isn't worse than before.
- **Narrow desktop windows:** below 1024 px the wheel scrolls without Lenis smoothing over the columns but with it elsewhere (already accepted as D1).
- **Test gaps:** the sticky check misses values like `top-[96px]`; CML4 is declared before CML3; CML2 depends on attribute order.

Architecture note for B: none. It's a class-only change and should stay as it is.

**Not done by me:**
- I didn't run the pre-flight skill or read the primitive files, since the patch wrote everything and I edited no code by hand. I read the active summary and the lessons only after applying the patch.
- I ran no browser checks, full test suite, build or `npm run verify`; those belong to C and the root gate.
- Doc 323 line 4 already says "C round 502 PASS", as B's task requires; it only becomes true once C passes.
- The real-backend cart check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

**Next for C:** rows C0–C13 from the task, heaviest first: C1 (layout states), C3 (short-screen wheel and focus ring), C7 (phone journey with the mock API). Use the server already running at http://127.0.0.1:5173.

The full report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-502.md`.
